description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class CustomFieldModelTest that tests the toArray() method of the CustomFieldModel class, which models a CustomField entity in the HRM system. It sets up a CustomField object with specific data, wraps it in a CustomFieldModel, and asserts that the output matches expected array data.

classes.name: CustomFieldModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomFieldModel's toArray method

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests that the CustomFieldModel correctly converts a CustomField object to an associative array
